latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of inbox-action-board

- Organizes emails or messages into four actionable categories: reply, waiting, follow-up, archive.
- Offers structured outputs to help with triage and productivity workflows.
- Keeps actions read-only and auditable; does not directly send, delete, or modify original messages.
- Provides clear boundaries and risk notes for sensitive or high-risk information.
- Supports both shell execution and text generation based on templates, depending on runtime environment.
